$comment: Hard limits and defaults of the user's comfort and safety preferences (issue #20). These are the ranges a person may set in the app. humidity.maxPct is the humid-air warning threshold, never a refusal (#248). The heat caps (#266) may only be stricter: their max may not exceed the health constants (heat index 32.2 C, 31 C with an older person), and the guard clamps on read. Values approved in #20 and #248; changeable by the owner.
